At Andatech, we believe in responsible driving and smarter choices. That’s why we’re launching #PassTheKey – a movement to encourage safe driving habits and responsible key passing with the Andatech GT Breathalyser.

And here’s the best part – we’re rewarding 10 qualified participants with $250 each!

✅ Get your Andatech GT Breathalyser

📸 Post on Instagram

  • Share a photo or video showing how you use your Andatech GT Breathalyser to promote responsible driving.
  • Use the hashtags #PassTheKey #AndatechGT and tag @andatech.au to spread the message!

📩 Submit Your Proof

  • DM us @andatech.au with your valid tax invoice and Instagram post link

settings.heading: Promote Road Safety
settings.text: Your post can inspire others to make responsible choices.

settings.heading: Score $250!
settings.text: 10 qualified participants will receive $250 as a reward for their effort and creativity!
Grab your Andatech GT, get creative, and be one of the qualified 10 to win $250! 🚗💨

• The campaign runs until 31 March 2025. 10 qualified participants will be announced 7 days after the campaign ends.
  • This campaign is open to individuals who own an Andatech GT Breathalyser and can provide a valid proof of purchase (tax invoice).
  • Participants must be 18 years or older and reside in Australia.
  • Employees of Andatech and their immediate family members are not eligible to participate.
  • Participants must create a public Instagram post featuring a photo or video demonstrating how they use their Andatech GT Breathalyser to promote responsible driving.
  • The post must include the hashtag #PassTheKey #AndatechGT and tag @andatech.au.
  • Participants must submit their valid tax invoice and a link to their Instagram post via DM to be eligible.
  • 10 qualified participants who meet the requirements will receive a $250 credit to their Australian bank account.
  • Andatech reserves the right to verify entries and disqualify any submission that does not meet the campaign requirements.
  • By participating, entrants agree that Andatech may share, repost, or use submitted content (photo/video and caption) for promotional purposes on Andatech’s social media, website, or marketing materials.
  • Andatech reserves the right to modify, extend, or cancel the campaign at any time without prior notice.
  • Any fraudulent or misleading entries will result in disqualification.
  • Personal information collected during this campaign will be used solely for the purpose of verifying eligibility and processing refunds in accordance with Andatech’s Privacy Policy.
